title: Traction Kit & Comfort Aids
description: Skin traction kits, leg and ankle traction braces, cervical pillows, and comfort cushions for patient care and pressure relief.

products.name: Skin Traction Kit
features: Complete kit includes foam-backed adhesive traction strips, spreader bar, and traction cord
Hypoallergenic adhesive minimises skin reaction during extended application
Spreader bar prevents pressure on the malleoli
Suitable for paediatric and adult lower limb traction
benefits: Applies longitudinal traction to the lower limb for fracture management and pre-operative positioning
Reduces muscle spasm and pain in femoral and tibial fractures before surgical fixation
Used in paediatric orthopaedics for developmental hip conditions
Allows nursing staff to manage traction without specialist equipment

products.name: Leg Traction Brace
features: Adjustable frame with integrated traction mechanism for the lower limb
Foam-padded thigh and calf contact zones for patient comfort
Ratchet tensioning system allows precise force application
Lightweight aluminium construction for use in bed or during transport
benefits: Maintains traction on the leg for fracture alignment and muscle spasm relief
Reduces the need for skeletal traction in suitable fracture patterns
Allows nursing care to continue without disrupting traction force
Suitable for use during inter-hospital patient transfer

products.name: Ankle Traction
features: Ankle harness with padded malleolar protection and traction attachment point
Adjustable straps distribute traction force evenly around the ankle
Compatible with standard traction frames and bed setups
Durable construction suitable for sustained clinical use
benefits: Applies controlled traction to the ankle for subtalar joint mobilisation
Used in manual therapy and physiotherapy for ankle joint distraction
Reduces compressive joint forces to relieve ankle osteoarthritis pain
Supports rehabilitation protocols requiring joint distraction techniques

products.name: Cervical Pillow
features: Contoured memory foam or fibre-fill core supports the natural cervical curve
Butterfly-shaped design cradles the head in both supine and side-lying positions
Removable washable pillow cover for hygiene maintenance
Medium-firm density balances support and comfort
benefits: Maintains the cervical spine in a neutral position during sleep
Reduces morning neck stiffness and headaches from poor sleep posture
Prescribed for cervical spondylosis, disc herniation, and post-whiplash management
Helps prevent neck muscle strain in patients who work long hours at a desk

products.name: Coccyx Seat Cushion
features: U-shaped cutout eliminates direct pressure on the coccyx
Memory foam or gel-infused fill distributes sitting load across the ischial tuberosities
Non-slip base keeps the cushion stable on all seating surfaces
Removable zipped cover for easy washing
benefits: Relieves coccydynia pain during prolonged sitting
Reduces pressure on the tailbone after coccyx fracture or bruising
Suitable for post-partum patients with coccygeal pain following childbirth
Improves sitting comfort for patients with haemorrhoids and post-surgical perianal wounds

products.name: Back Rest Cushion
features: Lumbar roll or wedge design supports the natural lumbar lordosis
Firm supportive foam retains its shape through extended daily use
Adjustable strap attaches to most office chairs, car seats, and wheelchairs
Compact design for use at home, in the office, and during travel
benefits: Maintains correct lumbar posture during prolonged sitting to prevent low back pain
Reduces lumbar disc pressure by restoring the natural inward curve of the lower spine
Relieves chronic low back pain triggered by poor seating ergonomics
Suitable for patients recovering from lumbar surgery who must sit for extended periods
